prompt: For each customer country, which product category brings in the most revenue (excluding cancelled orders)? Show country and category.

meta.sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT c.country AS country, p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.country, p.category), ranked AS (SELECT country, category, revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM rev) SELECT country, category, revenue FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY country, category LIMIT 200

prompt: What was the average order value in 2025? Round to 2 decimals.

meta.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' LIMIT 200

prompt: Units sold per product category

meta.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 200

prompt: Revenue by product category

meta.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

prompt: Revenue for each of the last 3 months of data

explanation.correct: matches reading 2: same rows, same order

meta.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND date_trunc('month', o.order_date) >= date_trunc('month', (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders)) - INTERVAL '2 months' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_date) ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 200

prompt: Who is our best customer?

meta.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

prompt: Which month in 2025 had the largest increase in revenue compared with the previous month? Show the month and the increase.

meta.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1), changes AS (SELECT month, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS revenue_increase FROM monthly) SELECT month, revenue, revenue_increase FROM changes WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND revenue_increase IS NOT NULL ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC LIMIT 1

prompt: How many customers have bought products from at least 3 different categories?

meta.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) >= 3) t LIMIT 200

prompt: For each product category, what was the revenue growth from 2024 to 2025 as a percentage, rounded to 1 decimal?

meta.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END) AS revenue_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END) AS revenue_2025, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END), 0), 1) AS growth_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category LIMIT 200

prompt: how mny ordrs were canceld in 2024

meta.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' LIMIT 200

prompt: For each customer country, what percentage of its revenue comes from Electronics? Round to 1 decimal, highest first.

meta.sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'Electronics' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0), 1) AS electronics_revenue_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY electronics_revenue_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

prompt: top 3 prodcts by sales in 2024??

meta.sql: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

prompt: For customers with more than one order, what is the average number of days between their first and last order? Round to 1 decimal.

meta.sql: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MIN(order_date) AS first_order, MAX(order_date) AS last_order FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT ROUND(AVG(last_order - first_order), 1) AS avg_days_between_first_and_last_order FROM per_customer LIMIT 200

prompt: Show the running total of revenue by month for 2025.

meta.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_date)) SELECT month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

prompt: Compare revenue in Q3 2024 with Q3 2025.

meta.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.order_date >= DATE '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-10-01') OR (o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01')) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY year LIMIT 200

prompt: How many different customers placed orders in each month of 2025?

explanation.correct: matches reading 1: same rows, same order

meta.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date) ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

prompt: Which employees were hired in the same year as the most recently hired employee? Names only.

meta.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) = (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(hire_date)) FROM employees) ORDER BY name LIMIT 200

prompt: Which category has the highest average unit price paid on order lines, and what is it? Round to 2 decimals.

meta.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price_paid FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY AVG(oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

prompt: How many orders have more than 3 line items, and what share of all orders is that as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal?

meta.sql: WITH item_counts AS (SELECT o.id AS order_id, COUNT(oi.id) AS line_items FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE line_items > 3) AS orders_with_more_than_3_items, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE line_items > 3) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pct_of_all_orders FROM item_counts LIMIT 200

prompt: Number of customers per country, but only countries with more than 15 customers, biggest first

meta.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country LIMIT 200

prompt: Which customers spent more than 10,000 in 2025? Names and amount, highest first.

meta.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

prompt: What share of 2025 revenue came from the top 10 customers of 2025? Percentage rounded to 1 decimal.

meta.sql: WITH cust_rev AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.customer_id), top10 AS (SELECT revenue FROM cust_rev ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM top10) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM cust_rev), 0), 1) AS top10_revenue_share_pct LIMIT 200
